title: Tilemancer Dungeon
description:
Tilemancer dungeon is a minimalist dungeon crawler - card game where you create & explore your own dungeon by placing down room tiles.

Create your own path

Place tiles in the dungeon, in a card-like manner, to create your own path.

Each tile is a room that must be placed in a sequence so it connects to a previously placed tile. 

Each room contains either :

• An enemy

• A lootable chest

• A weapon

• A consumable

• A trap

• A piece of equipment

Fight your way through the dungeon

Use your weapons & abilities to make your way through the dungeon.

Set a target for your hero and he will move and fight on his own.

Alternate cleverly between enemies, potions & equipmentto survive.

Gather new playable allies

Beat other heroes to free them from the influence of the dungeon.

They will join your team as a new playable hero.

Each hero has his own abilities & his own way to navigate through the dungeon.

The Knights

Brave and strong.

Armed with their mighty sword and their sturdy shield, they will face their enemies head on. 

The Berserkers

A big axe and a bad temper.

They build up rage that makes them hit harder the more they fight. 

The Wizard & The Witch

Old and wise.

They can draw in their mana to cast powerful fireballs. 

The Rogues

Sneaky and light-footed.

They can avoid traps, sneak on enemies and lure them into traps.

The Cultists

Versed in the dark and the occult.

They draw their power from their enemies.

 

Gear up

Gather equipment in the dungeon or spend your hard earned coins to upgrade your damages & health. 

Claim the dungeon and become the next Tilemancer !
description_short: Tilemancer dungeon is a minimalist dungeon crawler - card game where you create & explore your own dungeon. Create your own path, fight your way through the dungeon, gear up and claim the dungeon to become the next Tilemancer !
